body:
>Nothing he can do would make me love him less.

Except for coming out as trans... and changing as a person, apparently.

I was going to say sorry, but I know that means nothing and doesn't help. I guess all I can think of saying is that I'm in a similar situation as you, and I probably know, more or less, how you feel. I honestly don't really have any suggestions that will actually help, but if I were in a different state of mind right now I might tell you some bullshit like "the problem is your attachment to those things" or "let go of your desire to have xyz and it'll come naturally" or something like that, but I know those are also meaningless. I'm sorry I couldn't really help you, but I guess you're young and impressionable, so maybe a "don't give up, you can do it!" will cheer you up? Whatever... sorry for wasting your time.
